slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: periods
slots.about: id (1 today, 2 this week, 3 this month, 4 all time), label; any subset, one chip each

slots.name: start_period
slots.about: the period id the screen opens on

slots.name: unit
slots.about: after every amount, with a leading space if a word

slots.name: selected_word
slots.about: spoken after the chosen chip's label, with a leading comma

slots.name: empty_period_line
slots.about: shown when nothing was logged in the chosen period

ranked.shows: every thing ranked by its total in the chosen period, rank number, name, total and a bar against the top total

zero_rows.shows: a thing with nothing in the period sits at the bottom with a dash for its rank and no bar

labels.chip: label, plus selected_word on the chosen one

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and smooth
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the chosen chip is said in words; every bar has its total in text
